::: {.intake-intro}
## Course entry questionnaire

Your answers—including your name—are saved only in this browser so the public course can remember that you completed the questionnaire. They are not transmitted to the course team or any survey server. Enter your own name as you want it associated with this browser-local course record; do not enter a participant's name or any participant information, health information, or other sensitive data. For affiliation, enter a university, laboratory, company, organization, or "Independent."
:::

<form class="course-intake-form" id="course-intake-form" novalidate>
<div class="form-field">
<label for="intake-name">Your name <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
<input id="intake-name" name="name" type="text" minlength="1" maxlength="100" autocomplete="name" required aria-describedby="intake-name-hint" />
<p class="form-hint" id="intake-name-hint">Enter your name as you want it to appear on your course record and certificate. It remains editable on the certificate page.</p>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
<label for="intake-role">Which role best describes you? <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
<select id="intake-role" name="role" required>
<option value="">Select one</option>
<option value="undergraduate-student">Undergraduate student</option>
<option value="graduate-student">Graduate student</option>
<option value="research-assistant-staff">Research assistant, coordinator, or laboratory staff</option>
<option value="researcher-analyst">Researcher, methodologist, or data analyst</option>
<option value="faculty-instructor">Professor, faculty member, or instructor</option>
<option value="clinician-public-health">Clinician, public-health, or health professional</option>
<option value="industry-consulting">Company, industry, or consulting professional</option>
<option value="government-nonprofit">Government or nonprofit professional</option>
<option value="other">Other</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
<label for="intake-affiliation">Affiliation or organization <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
<input id="intake-affiliation" name="affiliation" type="text" minlength="2" maxlength="150" autocomplete="organization" required aria-describedby="intake-affiliation-hint" />
<p class="form-hint" id="intake-affiliation-hint">For example: a university, laboratory, company, organization, or Independent.</p>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
<label for="intake-use">What will you mainly use this course for? <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
<select id="intake-use" name="intendedUse" required>
<option value="">Select one</option>
<option value="learn-foundations">Learn accelerometer fundamentals</option>
<option value="plan-study">Plan a new study or protocol</option>
<option value="process-data">Process or quality-check study data</option>
<option value="teach-train">Teach a class or train a research team</option>
<option value="evaluate-methods">Evaluate methods, software, or a wearable product</option>
<option value="professional-development">Professional development</option>
<option value="other">Other</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
<label for="intake-discovery">How did you hear about this course? <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
<select id="intake-discovery" name="discovery" required>
<option value="">Select one</option>
<option value="colleague-instructor">Colleague, supervisor, or instructor</option>
<option value="university-lab">University or laboratory website</option>
<option value="search-engine">Search engine</option>
<option value="github">GitHub</option>
<option value="social-media">Social media</option>
<option value="class-conference">Class, workshop, or conference</option>
<option value="other">Other</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="form-actions">
<button class="button button-primary" type="submit">Save answers and enter the course</button>
<a class="button button-secondary" href="index.html">Return to course home</a>
</div>
<p class="form-status" role="status" tabindex="-1" hidden></p>
</form>

::: {.review-note}
<strong>Static-site privacy note:</strong> This course is hosted on GitHub Pages and has no survey receiver. Completing this questionnaire unlocks the course on this device; your name and other answers remain in browser storage and are not sent to the course team. Clearing browser data will require you to complete it again.
:::
